init_hook: go version --short 2>/dev/null || echo '  ⚠️  Go: not found'
helm version --short 2>/dev/null || echo '  ⚠️  Helm: not found (install via: brew install helm or see README troubleshooting)'
kubectl version --client --short 2>/dev/null || echo '  ⚠️  kubectl: not found'
echo 'Note: Some tools (kubesec, pluto) need to be installed separately:'
echo '  Run: devbox run make install-tools'
echo 'Run: make help to see available commands'
echo 'Run: devbox run make build to build the project'

install-tools: make kubesec-install || echo '⚠️  kubesec installation skipped'
make pluto-install || echo '⚠️  pluto installation skipped'
pre-commit-install: make pre-commit-install || echo '⚠️  Pre-commit installation skipped'
